one_line: A robotic swarm antagonist that eats metal/glass for resources, fabricates shock traps and blockades, and teleports crew away to avoid combat.
player_facing_mechanics: Eat metal/glass items and certain machines to gain resources (up to a max of 100, starting at 20)
Disintegrate structures/machines/furniture (walls, windows, doors, vending machines, cameras, lights) via swarmer_act
Dismantle machines over a 10-second uninterrupted do_after to yield 5 iron sheets
Self-repair to full health after a 10-second delay
Fabricate a swarmer trap (4 resources) that nonlethally electrocutes/paralyzes non-swarmers who cross it
Fabricate a swarmer blockade (4 resources) that blocks non-swarmers but lets disabler beams and swarmers through
Fire a swarmer disabler beam from a ranged component
Right-click a living target to teleport them away (energy-cuffing humans) after a 3-second delay, only on station/mining z-levels
Revive dead fellow swarmers with a 20-second jumpstart/shock
Contact all other swarmers with a free-text announcement
See a HUD resource counter on the alien plasma display slot and a Resources line in the status tab
Take stamina-based melee damage (deals stamina), is immune to tox/stamina/oxy and unsuitable atmos/cold/heat damage
Swarmer trap/blockade and swarmer mob allow friendly fire of disabler beams and movement through each other
Is vulnerable to EMP (EMP_act damages/near-death), with no fire/acid/EMP resistance on structures except FIRE_PROOF/UNACIDABLE/ACID_PROOF
Spawned midround from ghosts as a team; objective is to harvest the most resources of any swarmer by round end
Round-end report lists each swarmer, resources harvested, and the 'most obnoxious' winner

port_notes: The mob, actions, structures, projectiles and HUD map reasonably onto SS14 ECS: a SwarmerComponent holding resources plus SwarmerSystem for resource gain, fabricating traps/blockades as spawned entities, a RangedAttack-style action, and an innate-action set for light/repair/teleport. The swarmer_act dispatch is the hard part: SS13 overloads a proc per atom type; SS14 would need an interaction/event (e.g. a SwarmerInteract action or an InteractUsing-style hook) with a per-prototype flag for consume/dismantle/forbidden and data-driven abort reasons, plus airtight hull-breach checks using the SS14 atmos grid instead of turf-level pressure probes. Antag/round-end mechanics map onto GameRule + round-end system and a SwarmerRole/AntagObjective; the dynamic-ruleset weighting needs re-expression in the game-rule scheduling model. A human must decide how faithfully to reproduce the pressure-safety and z-level teleport restrictions, and whether the free-text TGUI contact broadcast and music-note language are worth porting or should be simplified.
